Water Improvements
Water has long been the least rewarding part of the map: costly to enter, limiting in combat, and visually flat. This update takes on all three, on the world map, in battle and on screen.
World Map Gameplay
Embarking now has a flat cost, Outposts can be founded on water provinces, and the Random Map Generator has been retuned so oceans shape the layout of a realm.
Movement & Settlement
Renamed terrain types: Ocean is now Deep Ocean, Coastal is now Ocean and Water is now Underground Water.
Changed the cost of embarking a unit from all of its Movement Points (minimum 12) to a flat 20 Movement Points.
Added the same +2 Vision granted to Embarked Units to Aquatic Units.
Added founding Outposts on habitable provinces with water in the center. These Outposts cannot be converted into Cities, except by the Mercantile Culture.
Added building the Spelljammer, Beacon of Unity and Teleporter Special Province Improvements on water provinces.
Random Map Generator
Continents
Increased ocean size and made continents more consistent in size, so the sea plays a bigger role in how a realm is laid out.
Changed continents belonging to AI players so they can connect to each other by land, instead of always being separated by water.
Changed AI players to no longer be placed on a shared continent with another player by default. Human players still start on a shared continent so they can reach each other early.
Coastal: Changed the ocean to sit in one corner of the map instead of being spread around the edges, with fewer and smaller islands.
Divide: Removed the islands along the ocean that splits the two continents, and increased the width of that ocean considerably, so it reads as a proper ocean rather than a wide river.
Islands
Removed the Lava terrain overlay, removing unsightly lava/ocean borders.
Changed resource values: lower on land, higher on the ocean.
Combat Gameplay
Embarked units follow their own rules for turning and positioning, with stats adjusted to match, and summons, resurrections, transformations and teleports now work at sea.
Embarked
Added Large Target and Reinforced.
Added -2 Fire Protection.
Removed -2 Defense and -2 Resistance.
Removed the damage reduction due to casualties.
Added Limited Maneuverability to embarked units, Ghost Ships and Ironclads:
Units spend Movement Points each time they turn while moving.
Using the Rotate Unit Ability spends all of the unit's remaining Movement Points.
Units cannot use Opportunity Attacks or Retaliations against hexes behind them.
Added Amphibious Movement to Ironclads.
Abilities & Spells on Water

Added the Water Walk passive, which is granted in combat to any unit that cannot cross the current map's terrain on its own (for example a land unit summoned on a water map), allowing it to use land movement on water hexes.
Changed abilities and spells that summon, resurrect or transform units to work on water maps (with a few rare exceptions, mostly involving plants).
Changed magical teleport abilities (e.g. Teleportation) to work on water.
Changed non-magical teleport abilities (e.g. Disengage Unit) to only be blocked while the unit is embarked.
Changed Amphibious units to become Wet while on water.
Visual Improvements

Water rendering has been reworked for readability, every aquatic battle map has been redressed with new props and sea life, and ships now carry the look of the culture that sails them, with new skins in Faction Creation.
Ship Customization
Added 3 unique Boat Skins to choose from during Faction Creation: Default, Graceful and Brutal.
Added a default ship style for each culture.
Changed Free Cities to use the ships of their associated faction, Dwellings to use their own boats where available, and other independents to use Marauder ships.

Trade Routes

Trade Routes are a new economic system that connects your Cities to Outposts, Free Cities, and the Cities of other Empires. Each Route is built and owned by a single City, which receives the Route's income; what you gain depends on what the Route connects to. Routes can be raided in open war, and a new line of City structures lets you specialize a City around its trade.
General
Trade Routes are created from the Trade Route panel and are built through the Unit Production Queue.
A Trade Route's Draft cost depends on its target and distance.
Trade Route production can be hurried.
Creating a Trade Route requires the target City to have been explored.

notes.title: Trade Route capacity is per City

items.text: 1 Route by default.
+1 per core Trade structure (Trade Post, Trade Quarters, Trade Bazaar).
+1 from the Caravaneer's Guild.
+3 in every City when the Megacities realm trait is active, or when your faction has the Chosen Destroyers Society Trait.
Trade Routes are guarded by Trader Escorts. Escort strength depends on the City's Trade structures:
Base: 2× Tier 1.
Trade Post: 3× Tier 1, 1× Tier 2.
Trade Quarters: 3× Tier 1, 3× Tier 2.
Trade Bazaar: 1× Tier 1, 3× Tier 2, 2× Tier 3.
Trade Routes are automatically regenerated or destroyed when territory along their path changes owner. The City's owner receives a notification explaining what happened.
Trade Routes also regenerate automatically when a province along their path is terraformed.
Trade Routes that pass through territory the owner no longer has access to are rerouted.
Nomad Cities: Trade Routes are restored for free when the settler unpacks.
Province Improvement “Teleporter”
Changed Upkeep from a local Outpost upkeep to a global empire upkeep of 10 Mana, so it no longer interacts with Trade Route income.
Economy
Culture Trait “Tyrannical Exploitation” (Dark)
Reduced Bonus from 20% to 2% per allegiance, to account for the much larger income now gained from Vassals.
Changed to only apply to Vassal tribute when an active Trade Route to that Vassal exists.
Description - Updated to state the 2% bonus instead of the previous 20%.
Culture Trait “Potential of Growth” (Mystic) - Removed its effect on Outposts.
Culture Trait “Potential of Control” (Mystic) - Removed its effect on Outposts.
Empire Skill 9B “Absolute Loyalty” (Order) - Reduced the Income bonus from Supreme Vassalage from +40% to +20%.
Society Trait “Chosen Uniters” - Reduced Income Bonus from +30% to +10%.
Interface
Added a Trade Routes overlay toggle to the overview map.
Trade Routes are otherwise only visible when a City is selected, an army is standing on a Route, or the Economic Overview is open.
Trade Route income is listed under its own “Trade Route” entry in the City income overview.
Added Trade Route information to the Outpost panel, including whether a Trade Route is connected and, if so, to which City.
Added a combat preview for battles involving Trade Routes.
Added tooltips for Trade Routes, including while they are still in the production queue.
Notifications
Added a notification when a Trade Route is completed.
Added separate notifications, each with its own message and event icon, for when one of your Trade Routes is raided, removed or rerouted.
Added a Trade Route Income concept, linked from the Trade Route tutorial and the Trade Route concept.
City Structures

Three core Trade structures, unlocked by City tier, grow with the City. Each also offers a choice between two mutually exclusive sub-structures, so a City can lean toward Outposts and Free Cities or toward trade with other Empires.
Trade Post (Tier 2)
Requires Town Hall II.
+1 Trade Route Capacity.
Increases the strength of Trade Route Escorts.
Grants +5 Gold to this City's owner for each Trade Route owned by another City that connects to this City.

notes.title: Unlocks one of the following (mutually exclusive)

items.text: Outpost Supply Hub
Outposts connected to this City by Trade Route provide +50% income.
Diplomatic Embassy
Each Trade Route with another Empire's City grants this City +5 Imperium.
Trade Quarters (Tier 3)
Requires Trade Post.
+1 Trade Route Capacity.
Increases the strength of Trade Route Escorts.
Grants +10 Gold to this City's owner for each Trade Route owned by another City that connects to this City.

notes.title: Unlocks one of the following (mutually exclusive)

items.text: Food Importers
Each Trade Route with an Outpost or Free City grants this City +20 Food and +10 Stability.
Wizard's Exchange
Each Trade Route with another Empire's City grants this City +10 Knowledge and +10 Mana.
Trade Bazaar (Tier 4)
Requires Trade Quarters.
+1 Trade Route Capacity.
Increases the strength of Trade Route Escorts.
Grants +15 Gold to this City's owner for each Trade Route owned by another City that connects to this City.

notes.title: Unlocks one of the following (mutually exclusive)

items.text: Caravaneer's Guild
+1 Trade Route Capacity.
Trade Routes cost 20% less Draft in this City.
Counts as a Guild; a City may only have one Guild.
Taxation Offices
Each Trade Route grants this City +5 Gold and +5 Stability.
Targets
Outposts
Outposts no longer have an economy of their own: a Trade Route makes an Outpost an extension of the connected City, sending everything its Domain produces there.
Outposts no longer cost 10 Gold upkeep.
Outposts provide no income until connected by a Trade Route.
An Outpost connected by a Trade Route sends all Local and Global income from its Domain to the connected City.
Each Outpost can only be connected to one City.
Outposts no longer receive Resource Sharing. This closes an exploit where Corrupt Pact would also grant its Food bonus to Outposts connected by a Trade Route.
Free Cities
Free Cities normally pay Tribute in Gold and Mana only. A Trade Route opens up their full output, Local resources included, and lets you steer what they produce through Trade Focuses.
A Trade Route can be established with any Free City you have at least a Pact of Cooperation with.
Base Free City Tribute (without a Trade Route) is capped at 10% of its Gold and Mana income.
Trade Route income from a Free City is a percentage of its income, set by your diplomatic state with it:
War: 5%
Pact of Cooperation: 5%
Pact of Loyalty: 10%
Establishing a Trade Route to a Free City grants +100 Relation with it.

notes.title: Trade Focuses replace the old Free City trade options

items.text: Available with any Free City you have a Trade Route with.
Costs Imperium per turn (5 at base) and lasts until cancelled.
Increases the Free City's output of the chosen resource by 50%, raising the income supplied through the Route.
Only one Focus can be active per Free City; the available options depend on the resources it produces.
Trade Focus treaties can be cancelled from the Diplomacy Overview screen.
Magic Material trades remain available.
Foreign Cities
With a Free Trade Agreement in place, two Empires can build Routes into each other's Cities.
Unlocked after a Wizard Bond.
While active, both Empires may build Trade Routes to each other's Cities.
Ending the agreement cancels all Routes between the two Empires.
A Trade Route to another Empire's City grants 20% of the target City's Gold and Mana income.
Raiding
Raiding is a wartime action: it requires a declared war, plays out as a full battle against the Route's Trader Escorts, and pays out well if you win.
Raiding requires being at war with the Route's owner. Attempting to raid without a war prompts you to declare one.
Raiding a Trade Route triggers a 1v1 battle against its Trader Escorts, with no reinforcements for either side. Surviving units keep any damage they took.
A successful raid grants a one-time reward of 3× the Route's per-turn income.
Routes destroyed when a City is occupied or conquered count as raided and grant raid income.

Fixed an issue where Primal Zombies would wear the wrong outfit.
Forms & Rigs
Fixed an issue where female Molekin and Ratkin models had deformation issues.
Fixed an issue where the female Hare had a broken neck mesh and Hare heads would clip.
Fixed an issue where Lizardfolk heads would look slightly cross-eyed, and where the Lizardfolk Eyebrow customization option would look wrong when zoomed out.
Fixed an issue where lupine and goat ears had animation issues.
Fixed an issue where several forms and units would blink incorrectly, including half blinks and only a single eye blinking.
Fixed an issue where Hare Rulers and Heroes could grow human beards.
Fixed an issue where Avian feathers would be rendered single-sided and disappear when viewed from behind.
Customization
Fixed an issue where selecting a form, entering customization and then switching to another form would mix the two forms' customization items together.
Fixed an issue where Owlkin helmets would show the hairstyle, crest and eyebrows through the helmet.
Fixed an issue where an extra hat would show underneath the Crown.
Fixed an issue where Godir crowns would be missing their circlet rings.
Fixed an issue where the Vampire Elder customization option would not show Cat Ears.
Fixed an issue where female Elysian ear feathers 4 and 5 would clip through each other.
Fixed an issue where Ogre horns would display incorrectly.
Fixed an issue where the head top orientation would be off for female forms.
Units & Animations
Fixed an issue where the Accursed Ogre had animation issues.
Fixed an issue where the Nomad Champion's turn animation would play incorrectly.
Fixed an issue where an Architect unit had a texture issue.
Fixed an issue where the Mystic Projection unit's outfit would show a broken model when the unit was dead.
Fixed an issue where disbanded units would play their death animation.
Fixed an issue where the Goretusk Matriarch was missing its attack and corpse-eating animations.
Fixed an issue where the Direcaster was missing its ranged/spellcasting attack animation.
Fixed an issue where Vampiric Flight animations would play incorrectly on Magic Fighter units.
Mounts
Fixed an issue where units riding camels would have floating or missing reins.
Fixed an issue where the Weaver Spider mount would make the hero appear small in the Hero screen compared to other spider mounts.
Fixed an issue where the colour of a Ruler's mount would change with the “Armor Color” setting.
Fixed an issue where units on Scorpion Mounts would float above their mount.
Weapons & Projectiles
Fixed an issue where weapons would snap incorrectly on polearm units with the Naga, Gloomstrider, or Sharktail Transformation.
Fixed an issue where crossbow and rifle aiming and attachment were incorrect on various unit forms.
Fixed an issue where the crossbow projectile visual was incorrect and the Ranger's Scatter Shot and Power Shot projectiles had ill-fitting visual effects.
Fixed an issue where the projectile of the Inquisitor's Shoot Crossbow and Bolt of Judgement abilities would appear from the unit's sword.
Fixed an issue where the Fire Heavy Magelock projectile was missing its muzzle flash and firing sound.
Visual Effects & Textures
Fixed an issue where the Fire Eye Happening visual would appear on unit panels and custom icon backgrounds, and adjusted its position on Monster units.
Audio
Fixed an issue where the Axe & Breachgun would be missing a firing sound when using Fire Breachgun.
Combat
Fixed an issue where unit auto-cast spells would only trigger for the first player in turn order.
Fixed an issue where Leaders summoned during combat would incorrectly count as real Leaders.
Fixed an issue where Grasping Vines would be applied for the wrong number of turns.
Fixed an issue where Astral Pull and Weaver's Retreat were incorrectly treated as Teleport abilities, subjecting them to Teleport restrictions.
Fixed an issue where Deathwaltz would not heal the target for 100% of its health.
Fixed an issue where Gravemarch, when combined with Keeper's Mark, would summon units directly instead of spawning corpses.
Fixed an issue where the turn could end while an auto combat was still being resolved.
Fixed an issue where a unit's innate damage reduction and damage channel weaknesses and resistances would not be applied in damage calculations.
Fixed an issue where unit tombstones would rise out of the ground again every time the turn changed in hotseat manual combat.
Combat Maps
Fixed an issue where the green targeting marker for corpses would sometimes not appear.
Fixed an issue where a section of stone bridge in the Umbral Tear combat map could not be walked on.
Fixed an issue where Spawn Points of Infestation would load a land battle map instead of an ocean one, or vice versa, depending on their theme or overlay.
Fixed an issue where Underground Passages would load a land battle map when placed on water overlays or themes.
Cultures
Fixed an issue where the Mystic Culture would start with 5 units instead of 4.
Fixed an issue where capturing and losing Spirit Dens would not always count toward the Primal culture quest objective. Losing a Den after the objective is completed no longer un-completes it.
Diplomacy
Fixed an issue where the Silver Tongued Society Trait would not discount the Imperium cost of House trade treaties.
Fixed an issue where House treaties would display a cost when they are free; the cost breakdown is now shown only in the tooltip.
Fixed an issue where Corrupt Pact could be cast on a Free City you are at war with.
Fixed an issue where vassal Free Cities protected by spell jammers could still be targeted with Corrupt Pact.
Fixed an issue where taking over a Free City would not cancel a Corrupt Pact cast on it by another Ruler.
Dwellings & Free Cities
Fixed an issue where relations with Free Cities and Dwellings would advance to the next diplomatic state even when progress toward that state was not allowed.
Fixed an issue where independent factions' territorial missions would target armies they were not at war with, caused by one-sided war states.
Fixed an issue where Rally of the Lieges for Dwellings would be wrongly limited by tier.
Economy
Fixed an issue where resource-sharing operations would not stop when the city being shared with was absorbed by another city.
Empire
Fixed an issue where combat summons such as Astral Reflection copies would be revivable with Unnatural Recovery after combat, allowing permanent copies of units.
Nature
Skill 10 “Druidic Empire” - Fixed an issue where it would grant +1 Knowledge, Mana and Gold per Population to Outposts; it now only affects Cities, as its description states.
Order
Skill 3 “Spiritual Conviction” - Fixed an issue where it would grant +10 Mana per City Stability above Neutral to Outposts; it now only affects Cities, as its description states.
Events
Fixed an issue where Kill Unit objectives would not complete when the target was defeated by another player.
Fixed an issue where manually spawned events belonging to a Crisis would not use the Crisis event layout.
Fixed an issue where the Umbral Dwelling's Boost Allegiance event was not linked.
Fixed an issue where the Cosmic Happenings “Asteroid” outro event would not trigger.
Fixed an issue where a Mystic Seer story event contained a grammar error.
Fixed an issue where some exploration site events (Empires & Ashes) would be missing Hero names.
Factions
Fixed an issue where the Reaver subculture would only apply to the Ruler, not their faction, for Fauster, Edward, and Valery.
Fixed an issue where mount customization options in Faction Creation were sorted incorrectly.
Fixed an issue where an Owlkin outfit had an incorrect unlock requirement.
Fixed an issue where customization item option lists could contain duplicate entries.
General
Fixed an issue where the Infinite Potential achievement would not trigger for players without Rise from Ruin.
Heroes
Fixed an issue where summoned Heroes would incorrectly be marked as stack leaders.
Unit “Elder Vampire”
Fixed an issue where Vampire Rulers could incorrectly gain Transformations through Ascension.
Fixed an issue where Siphon Blood and Draining Bite would be unusable.
Fixed an issue where Nightlord would not always be active on the Umbral Abyss and Shadow realm layers.
Fixed an issue where Vampiric Flight would have the wrong value.
Interface
Fixed an issue where some UI icons and images would fail to display after playing for a while, and icons would be shown at different zoom levels.
Fixed an issue where the number of research turns remaining would be displayed inconsistently between screens.
Fixed an issue where production queue timers for units would show the wrong number of turns.
Fixed an issue where the Outpost name prefix would appear in the wrong position.
Fixed an issue where overview map icons for Ancient Wonders from the base game, Giant Kings, and Thrones of Blood, and for the Crystal Forest, had incorrect sizes.
Fixed an issue where the Hero Customization screen would not respect visibility settings.
Fixed an issue where the Combat Preview screen would not close when another event was selected.
Fixed an issue where the Appearance settings would offer mount appearance options that are blocked for that Ruler.
Fixed an issue where the starting loadout Grimoire items had incorrect icons.
Fixed an issue where Sector Improvement tooltips would show requirement and cost elements when there are none.
Fixed an issue where the tactical combat top bar would show a dark rectangle sticking out when it expanded to fit additional resources.
Fixed an issue where the UI would not generate previews for “Target Self” abilities.
Fixed an issue where a tooltip error would occur when checking whether a relation can be boosted.
Fixed an issue where controller button glyphs would not update when switching input devices.
Fixed an issue where a map overlay was missing its color on the overview map.
Fixed an issue where the quest objective icon on the minimap would not update when the objective's target moved.
Fixed an issue where a ruined Blood Glass node would use the icon of an intact node on the overview map.
Fixed an issue where structure and district markers would render beneath domain borders.
Added a scrollbar to the House interaction buttons for when they do not all fit on screen (mainly at the largest interface scale).

Fixed an issue where combat damage previews would predict far more damage than was actually dealt. Previews no longer include the effects of damage response properties (such as Vengeful Flames) and damage reflection.
Fixed an issue where story event choices would not preview that losing allegiance would drop a Free City or Dwelling to a lower diplomatic state.
Text & Descriptions
Fixed an issue where the Teleport ability requirement had an incorrect description.
Updated the Umbral Flesh description to mention that it also affects Outposts.
Updated the Seekers of Wonders description: Outposts are included in the free annexation, but not in the extra income.
Fixed an issue where Spellblade did not mention its use of Ranged Weapons.
Fixed an issue where Large Target incorrectly stated that units were immune to displacement and knockback effects.
Fixed an issue where the Umbral Mistress's Gratitude ability description said it bypasses Defense; it now says unblockable damage.
Fixed an issue where the Goldseeker Pickaxe's Gilded effect description was missing a link to Turns and stated it lasts 1 turn instead of 2.
Removed an obsolete reference to Very Fast Movement from Advanced Logistics.
Fixed an issue where the Temple of the Exalted incorrectly stated that its governor bonus would be doubled in the city it was built in.
Fixed an issue where the Nautical Governor description did not specify Ocean and Underground water provinces.
Fixed an issue where the Watchtower City Upgrade tooltip would show wrong values.
Fixed an issue where the Healing Spires City Upgrade was missing hyperlinks and a description.
Updated the Shrouded Isle layer description to note that it cannot be terraformed.
Fixed an issue where Mana Starved's description contained a text error.
Fixed an issue where the Empire Development skill descriptions and tooltips contained multiple minor typos.
Fixed an issue where the defeat message when defeated by raiders had a plural grammar error.
Fixed an issue where the “Draft Blocked”, “Growth Blocked” and “Production Blocked” tooltips would always say “turns”, even with 1 turn remaining.
Fixed an issue where the Pall of Gloom (Umbral Disciples Society Trait, Eldritch Realms) description would be missing values.
Fixed an issue where the Tome of the Crimson Reign (Thrones of Blood) description would be cut short while researching the Tome.
Fixed an issue where the Cosmic Affinity skill tooltips would show broken text inserts.
Fixed an issue where Focus Crystal would state +10% Combat Experience in the magic material panel instead of the correct 20%.
Fixed an issue where Istarnech's heroes would have untranslated names in the Azh'ruun Pit.
Fixed various translation issues in Spanish, Korean, Polish and Russian.
Item Forge & Equipment
Fixed an issue where hero items would display the wrong damage value in the UI.
Modding
Fixed an issue where realm info would not correctly report whether a realm is modded.
Pantheon
Fixed an issue where the Conquerors and City Conquest Pantheon unlocks would trigger when migrating your own city.
Performance
Fixed an issue where opening the unit panel would be slow and its animations would start late.
Spells
Fixed an issue where the Move Portal action would take away a spell slot when cancelled; special operations not shown in the Spellbook no longer take up slots.
Fixed an issue where the Spell Discount Backfire effect would also apply to other operations.
Fixed an issue where summoning spells could still summon units onto hexes adjacent to an occupied city.
Fixed an issue where spell targeting was only cancelled when pressing Cancel; closing the spell screen in any other way now also cancels it.
Fixed an issue where World Spell “Pall of Gloom” could not be cast on Surface provinces that include Ocean, Lava, Astral Barrens or Umbral terrain hexes.
Fixed an issue where World Spell “Desecration Ritual” could not be cast on Surface provinces that include Ocean, Lava, Astral Barrens or Umbral terrain hexes.
Story Realms
Secrets of the Archmages
Fixed an issue where the Crisis of Carnage event would not reward the correct resources in Story Realm 2.
Fixed an issue in Story Realm 2 where “weekend” was written instead of “weakened”.
Thrones of Blood
Fixed an issue where certain quests in Story Realm 1 could still trigger when you were not eligible for them.
Fixed an issue where the Emperor NPC was unable to explore their starting area in Story Realm 1.
Archon Prophecy
Fixed an issue where the second Archon Prophecy Story Realm was missing its content filters.
Tomes
Astral
Tome of the Tentacle
Fixed an issue where Tendril Labyrinth would not function in water combat.
Materium
Tome of the Creator
Summon Spell “Call Titan of the Earth” - Fixed an issue where it would not remove Defense Mode and retaliations from Large Target units.
Tome of the Golden Realm
Major Race Transformation “Goldtouched” - Fixed an issue where it would grant +1 Gold per Population to Outposts; it now only affects Cities, as its description states.
Order
Tome of Abjuration
City Structure “Glyph Tower” - Fixed an issue where it would not grant Fortification Health when adjacent to a Research Post.
Tome of Subjugation
Fixed an issue where Final Ultimatum would only restore the target's morale instead of Mind Controlling it, because the Strong Willed it applied immediately cancelled the Mind Control.
Units
Unit “War Golem” - Fixed an issue where Fiery Shift would apply Burning to allies; it now only affects enemies.
Fixed an issue where the Umbral Mistress's Wrack ability would reference a broken property.
World Map
Fixed an issue where Subjugating Raid could be exploited to repeatedly remove population from a city.
Fixed an issue where the Raiding Party siege project would grant two tiers' worth of resources when breaching the walls of a Tier 1 city.
Fixed an issue where the Gold Cursed Captain would end up in prison or on the player's side after being summoned into combat.
Fixed an issue where the Gold Cursed Captain's units would remain Undead after completing the quest.
Fixed an issue where randomly generated Marauders could have both Demonkin and Holy Aura.
Fixed an issue where diggable earth sectors would sometimes have a random uncovered hex.
Fixed an issue where diggable earth could spawn on underground water hexes, covering up Underground Passages.
Fixed an issue where players would not always start with an Underground Passage nearby.
Fixed an issue where regions containing an Underground Passage would turn into water after generation.
Fixed an issue where a province in the Breached Isles could not be annexed.
Fixed an issue where the Beacon of Unity would change ownership after the raiding army was killed.
Fixed an issue where sector claims would not refresh when sector adjacencies changed, including through teleporters.
Fixed an issue where the Evergreen Breach Isle region used an outdated layout.
Fixed an issue where the Searing Dungeon in the Molten Scar Fated Region would no longer spawn inhabitants.
Fixed an issue where Terraforming “Desert”, “Arctic” and “Desolate” would not always change the affected province's terrain overlay to the new theme.
Fixed an issue where Chitinous Growths and Monoliths in the Umbral Abyss would grant duplicate resource income after a desync.

notes.title: Here is a look at what’s coming in the coming weeks

items.text: Today, we released our first hotfix addressing key issues
Next week, we will be releasing another hotfix fixing even more issues. (We’ll share more details in due time)

The week of February 24th , probably mid-week, we plan to release our first more important patch to improve optimization and our Callout Director, fixing the issues around the Callout distribution during Shifts and preventing having the two same Callouts in the same Shift.

Starting in March, we’ll probably deploy a new hotfix quickly after the release of February’s patch and will focus on a new major update planned for the middle of the month, fixing more bugs and addressing some of the feedback of the community.
Facebook Instagram TikTok Twitter
Discord Twitch Website
We are always listening closely to community feedback, but as we make any significant changes, there may be still players who have unique cases that need special care.
If even after installing all patches you are still experiencing crashes, freezes, and black screens, we need your help to find direct solutions for your problems.
Please follow this link to get us your specific details so we can investigate solutions for your case here:
The Swift Aid Siren’s brightness has been fixed
Fixed floating blood puddles
Fixed floating props in callouts
Fixed camera transition at vehicle start
Fixed holes in buildings
Fixed additional bus spawning in car crash callout
Fixed flickering skid marks
Fixed broken ventilation material in mall
Fixed clipping patient in Catastrophic Event 02 (The Burning Mall)
Fixed Muscle cramping Animation
Fixed the Partner’s suddenly disappearing hair
Fixed a bug where District unlocks would appear multiple times in the shift selection screen
The ambulance will no longer spawn on the roofs of cars when loading the last checkpoint
The “Panic Attack Training Callout“ will now correctly prompt you to use Lorazepam instead of Ketamine
You partner will no longer ask you to apply Glucose if the patient is suffering from Cardiac Arrest
Fixed "soft-blocking" dropdown input when using the back action
Fixed locked diagnosis entries when loading into an old save game shift
Fixed a bug where multiple dispatcher voices would be played simultaneously
Added additional Tooltips to the Scoring screen to provide more context on why a certain score was achieved
Increased the range of the siren’s effect on traffic to prevent cars from moving into the rescue lane
Pedestrians will now put in more effort to avoid the ambulance
You will now receive a prompt to reset your ambulance if it gets stuck on terrain
Lowered the chance that a callout spawns far away in the distance
Any patients that are not selected for treatment will now receive a marker indicating that another ambulance will pick them up afterwards
The “End Shift” prompt will now appear much faster after ending your final callout
Added jolts: Crashing into obstacles while transporting patients can now cause several different Injuries
Added additional useful hints to the loading screen
Made acceleration adaptive trigger much lighter
Added CPR handling for heart alarm display
Minor performance improvements
Updated recommendation for “third degree burns” to “burn dressings”
Added variable size for the transport event HUD
Significantly reduced the freakiness of our cables
Bleeding patients will now have growing blood patches on their clothes
Significant improvements to cutscene quality and ensured that the cutscene will play at a stable FPS
Implemented shift result background images
Fixed the missing District highlighting in the map screen
Improved our physical blood simulation
Brightened the dark corner within the “Bleeding” tutorial
Added near distance fade for gates in the District 2 hospital
Added a volume slider for the siren
The partner will only snap at you if you actually hurt the patient while driving
We are setting our sights on the Bayside Expansion release on April 22nd, so please stay tuned here and our official Discord for all the latest news and updates.

Thank you for sharing your feedback and experiences with us as we continue to address community concerns. Thank you for helping us continue shape Ambulance Life into the best version of itself it can be! ❤️
Facebook Instagram TikTok Twitter
Discord Twitch Website

items.text: Please find below the patch notes for next week’s update.
Version 1.3 will release on all platforms on Tuesday, December 16th, at 10AM UTC.
Fixed several crashes and performance issues
Fixed various causes for desyncs
With these desync fixes, we’ll also re-enable crossplay for Xbox since all 3 platforms will be on the same version again
Adde various updates and fixes to texts and localizations
Fixed an issue with deities (Ceres, Neptune, Mars) disappearing from the Religion menu
Fixed an issue making it impossible to upgrade blueprints of slot buildings (mountain, river, marshland) and farms
Pirate Ships will drop more items from now on when destroyed
Shrines are supported to be built on plazas tiles now.
The Credits movie now has subtitles.
Session generation has been improved. There should be no island missing any longer.
Please note this will change the seeds
General improvements to street- and path construction
Various improvements on the technical side, like refinement on game stability and performance, including:
A fix for heavy stutters during fights involving many ships and/or land units
A fix for heavy stutters when rivals triggered festivals under specific circumstances
A fix for benchmark stutters
A fix for the game not booting
A fix for slow performance on Intel GPUs
A fix for the lag when opening the Save Menu
Fixed an issue with the title freezing for 10 seconds after pressing the “Quit Game” button in the Main Menu.
Fixed an issue with the game crashing when moving an Aqueduct under certain circumstances
Fixed an issue that prevented the instant repair of ruins
Fixed an issue making it impossible to upgrade blueprints of slot buildings (mountain, river, marshland) and farms
Fixed an issue where destroyed shipyards of rivals continued to spawn ships
Fixed an issue with the trading post menu being unusable, when the trading post was destroyed with no villa present.
Fixed an issue with deities (Ceres, Neptune, Mars) disappearing from the Religion menu when the player disabled or lost access to the Hall of Fame
Fixed several issues with gates and walls
Gate could be constructed without available resources
Gates were not showing maintenance and build costs in construction bar
Walls could be placed on islands of rivals
Fixed an issue with the villa garrison cavalry in Albion requiring workforce
Fixed an issue with cisterns not having water supply costs
Fixed the Naumachia event not showing the naumachia (ship battles) all the time
Fixed an issue where extra-needs were consumed before they were unlocked via the research tree
Fixed an issue that broke the Research Tree queue after changing the research speed while research was ongoing
Unlocking a discovery via the Hall of Fame no longer unlocks the full cluster of research around it
Replaced the placeholder AI artwork in loading screen and campaign cinematic
Fixed an issue with City Status notification appearing too often.
Fixed an issue where rivals invited after the game started were not considering in the diplomacy comparison reasons
Fixed an issue with the deposed emperor still granting reputation
Fixed an exploit that allowed +100 reputation exploits
Improved the ship-boarding handling for land units
Fixed an issue with rival land units teleporting while patrolling
Fixed an issue where Ranged Units didn’t defend themselves in melee
Adjusted civilian ships to not follow a group-attack command any longer when grouped with warships
Fixed an issue with land units not defending themselves while partially embarked
Fixed an issue with the festival banner reappearing every single time a user jumped back to their island
Fixed an issue where pirates didn’t show up on the map
Fixed an issue with the Builder Pack content not being present on first boot of the game
Fixed an issue with new Asset ModOp
Fixed an issue with easy and medium rivals settling all islands in a session
Fixed an issue with marsh-only buildings of rivals not getting destroyed when the marsh is drained
Fixed an issue with rivals not considering the correct costs of building trading posts
Improved defensive behaviour of rivals during island invasions
Various desync fixes
Fixed an issue with the trade route warning messages missing their icons in multiplayer
Fixed an issue with the Save Game Menu being empty after enabling Persistent Coop during a session or loading into a Live Save Game
Added a confirmation pop-up when attempting to overwrite a cross-progression save file
Fixed an issue where in the setup screen of a multiplayer game (upon loading a savegame) players were shown as connected even if they weren’t present in the lobby
Locked the ‘City Status Impact On Incidents’ difficulty setting so that it’s only changeable by the host, not by other participants
Fixed an issue with Hall of Fame specialists not being available to other players than the host
Fixed an issue that prevented players from hosting a multiplayer game while “house access” was turned off
Improved the visibility in co-op when a fellow player selects or moves a building
Improved the UI of the multiplayer lobby
Fixed an issue with gamepad controls becoming unresponsive when a player’s or enemy’s land unit retreats
Fixed an issue with mines becoming selected when the mouse cursor is a significant distance away
Fixed an issue where trade routes couldn’t be renamed via gamepad
Fixed an issue with uppercase letters not being supported for savegames when using non-English keyboards
Fixed an issue with mouse and keybord not always working simultaneously on PlayStation 5
Fixed a highlighting issue when hovering over a drainage channel with a gamepad
Improved the placement of Ground Ornaments when using a gamepad
Added various usability improvements for gamepad
Fixed an issue where upgrading buildings from blueprint mode didn’t always have a sound effect
Improved the audio feedback upon claiming rewards in the Hall of Fame via gamepad
Various audio improvements, including a fix for audio degradation during extended play-sessions
The “Repairing Damage” infolayer is only visible when hovering on damaged buildings now. It’s not shown all the time a building is damaged anymore.
Improved and aligned visuals of connection slots of aqueducts and marshland buildings
Fixed an issue where trading post infotips weren’t accessible when the passive trade popup was open
Fixed an issue where a water-consuming building was listed in the menu of multiple cisterns in range of the building
Fixed an issue where Sheep were displayed instead of Flax in the Loungers production chain

Quest The Stuff of legends: Fixed an issue with localization

Quest Holy Stones: Fixed an issue that prompted players to deliver still-locked materials during the quest stage
Quest Cutting the Chain: Fixed an issue with the quest item spawning in another province
Quests Dominus Mirabilium: Adjusted the spawning position of the quest object
Fixed some wrong texts for in City Status names
Various changes and additions to the Credits
Various fixes for text and localization issues

notes.title: Tavern Gossip – what does the future hold?

items.text: Somewhere in Latium, an unlikely group assembled in a tavern. What they discussed there? Oh, just some rumours and speculations on what this year’s DLC will add to Anno 117: Pax Romana.
Listen in to their conversations below and learn what really concerns the Libertus.
Will you reassure the Libertus? Already planning your travel to Aegyptus? What are you most looking forward to?
Enjoy discounts on all Anno games here on Steam from February 26 to March 12.
Next week Thursday, March 5th, we’re planning to release patch 1.4.1 on all platforms.
This smaller patch will address several recent issues like for example:
The desync that happens if a co-op partner doesn’t own the Cosmetic DLC but tries to move objects that are part of the pack
The issue that resulted in raytracing being disabled on consoles since patch 1.4
Issues with Albion-related construction menu entries both when using mouse & keyboard as well as when using a gamepad
The full patch notes will be published next week.
Furthermore, here’s a heads-up on what you can expect in March!

Over the course of the next weeks and before we start talking about the “Prophesies of Ash” DLC in more detail, we’ll take you behind the scenes of our UI team. Senior UI Designers Christoph and Eva as well as Lead UI Designer Alexander will tell you about how we tackle both UI Design in general and the design of all the icons in Anno 117: Pax Romana.

releases.displayName: ROAD TO GLORY: PATCH NOTES + HOTFIX

items.text: Our latest update brought a few more bumps in the road than we’d planned for and, given the opportunity, the Asphalt Team are also bringing some of our planned economy balance changes alongside it.

Why now you ask? Since we have a new season coming, the hotfix allows us to deploy these changes earlier than our next update and gives us more time to collect your feedback for any future changes or adjustments.
As we mentioned in our 2026 Roadmap, rebalancing our economy is one of our main objectives and one that we will continue to work on and evolve throughout the year.
So, please remember, we’ll be paying attention to both your feedback and the impact these changes have in-game so we can continue to tweak and adapt any plans or adjustments.
The Hotfix will be released tomorrow, April 23rd at 10:00 GMT+2, with our new season set to start as planned on Tuesday, 28th of April.
Now, let’s start things off by having a look at what’s coming your way next season.
We’re excited to announce the return of hololive as they prepare for their final encore this season. One last big show and your last chance to get your favorite decals and emojis!
Work Hard Play Hard: (1/05 - 8/5) Celebrate Worker’s Day aboard the Zenvo Aurora Tur.
Cinco De Mayo: (5/5 - 12/5) Viva Mexico! A community favorite, the Lamborghini Revuelto, is here for the celebration!
Lamborghini Invencible Star Hunt: (8/5 - 19/5) Another Lambo is the star here as you hunt for BPs in the Lamborghini Invencible Star Hunt.
Int. Day of Families: (12/5 - 19/5) Come celebrate Dom’s favorite day aboard the Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 Clubsport, the Porsche 911 GT1 Evolution, and the Porsche Taycan Turbo S.
LEGO Technic Aston Martin Valkyrie Tour: (14/05 - 28/5) Another chance for you to collect any missing pieces to complete the set, this time with a Tour event!
Lamborghini Invencible Epic Hunt: (18/5 - 29/5) The Hunt continues, this time for import parts!
World Bee Day: (19/5 - 26/5) Tell all your worries to buzz off for a bit and ride aboard the ARASH AF8 Falcon Edition, the McLaren Solus GT, and the Mercedes-Benz AMG GT S .

Memorial Day: (25/5 - 01/6) Celebrate Memorial Day with an American inspired selection of cars, featuring the Ford GT MK II, the Cadillac Cien Concept, the Chevrolet Corvette ZR1, and the Trion Nemesis
Car Hunts: For this season you’ll be chasing after the Aston Martin Valour (12/5 - 25/05) and the Jaguar C-X75 (28/4 - 10/5)

hololive Final Encore Spotlight:(28/4 - 27/5) Last chance to get your favorite emojis and decals! Ride aboard the Honda Civic Type-R, Vanda Electrics Dendrobium, Glickenhaus 003S, Porsche 911 GT3 RS, Noble M600 Speedster, Nissan GTR-50 Italdesign, and the Aspark Owl to collect all the music notes and claim your rewards!

Mayhem Event Ares Panther: (05/05 - 28/05) Time for some Mayhem! Get your hands on the brand-new Ares Panther, the McLaren 600LT Spider, the Pagani Zonda Cinque, the Aston Martin DBS GT Zagato, the McLaren 650s GT3, the Ford GT MK IV, and the Mercedes-Benz Mercedes-AMG ONE.

Aglaia Special Event: (19/5 - 03/6) A special event full of heavy hitters, lead by the RAESR Aglaia, alongside the Dodge Charger SRT® Hellcat Redeye Widebody, the Aston Martin Valour, the Puritalia Berlinetta, the Lamborghini Essenza SCV12, the FV Frangivento Sorpasso GT3, and the Koenigsegg Jesko.

Pagani Imola Unleashed: (18/5 - 02/6) – Time for a new Unleashed, with the Pagani Imola, the Aston Martin Valhalla Concept Car, the Ferrari F8 Tributo, the Apollo EVO, and the Lamborghini Sesto Elemento.
Lamborghini Sterrato Grand Prix: (11/05 - 28/5) Think you have what it takes? Prove it on the track for a chance to get the key to a brand new Lamborghini!

Starway Vencer Sarthe: (28/4 - 27/5) The Starway this season will have you racing for the Vencer Sarthe, aboard the Dodge Viper ACR, the Ferrari Monza SP1, the Lamborghini Huracán Super Trofeo EVO, and the Lamborghini Countach 25th Anniversary.
Now, time to have a look at what is coming in our Hotfix, releasing tomorrow, 23rd of April at 10:00 GMT+2
First things first, let’s deal with the “fix” part! Here's the list of all the fixes included in our upcoming hotfix:
Floaty issue has been fixed: Good news! Your drift will no longer be interrupted by 360s or other tricks you perform on the track.
Crash Fixes across all platforms: The team has been able to resolve several issues that were causing the game to crash for some of our players, particularly those playing on Steam and the Epic store.
IOS Age verification Issue: Resolved an issue for some iOS players when facing an Age verification pop-up.
Empty Rewards Tab for Multiplayer: Multiplayer rewards were not showing for some players. This has been fixed.
Season Pass not appearing for some players: This should also be resolved, and the Season Pass should display correctly for all.
India Track Respawn Issue: Some players reported being respawned while in the air on some sections of the track.
Scotland Ramps: The crew managed to wrangle back those wild ramps that had appeared on the Scotland track. They’re back in the pen now, and all is back to normal.
Shop not appearing in Bluestacks: The shop should now be back as normal.
Leaderboard issues: The leaderboards were not updating correctly for some Ranked TLEs and a few Club sections. We’ve resolved the issue, and they should now populate correctly.

We will be tweaking our current Ads reward system, as currently we feel it may create an awkward experience. We want our events to be an experience rewarding and engaging enough for you to dedicate your time on, instead of having to focus on grinding stages to trigger ads.

We're taking measures to help players who need credits the most. Starting next season, players who are in earlier stages of their progression will see a boost in the credits they receive from credit multipliers. In the next update, we'll have the tools ready to fine-tune and extend that benefit to players in short supply of credits at any point of their journey.

We also overestimated the average amount of ads players normally watch, providing an unfair advantage to platforms without ads, as they can quickly go through 20 “ad tickets” a day, which very few of you end up benefiting from on platforms with ads.
So, to help level things out, platforms without ads will have their ad tickets reduced from 20 to 8, to better match the average experience amongst players.
As most of you are aware by now, we continue to work on fine tuning the contents of the Ultimate pass, and this time we have some exciting updates!
For this hotfix, and coming into play next season, we’ll be further changing the pass’ content, which will bring the Zenvo Aurora Tur as the featured car AND including the key for the Pagani Zonda R.
Already have the Zonda R? No worries, the key will be converted to 150,000 Trade Tokens, so you can still get some extra value from our Spotlights or Legends Store.

For the rest of the included rewards, we want to try and offer more active value and upgrades, compared to just adding more bulk resources, so have a look at the Ultimate Pass once the new season comes and let us know what you think of the changes!

We will also be tweaking event rewards from a season perspective, making sure we balance overall rewards from season to season, instead of from event to event. As we see players mostly focusing their time on our big ticket events, such as the Spotlight and Drive Syndicate which require time and dedication, we want to make sure that time is worthwhile spent, so we’ll be tweaking our reward distribution for Spotlights, Drive Syndicates and other Special Events.
Speaking of Drive Syndicate, the SC relays will be gaining 2 new steps at a premium, for those who need an extra boost in a rush.
We’ve heard you and agree that the new community car needs a bit more “umph!”. You can check the new stats here:
Didn’t we say we wanted to make playing events feel better than chasing multipliers?

Well, our next season will be coming with a new MAYHEM event, and for the first time ever, featuring a brand-new car: The Ares Panther! Check out our season event calendar above for the exact dates so you don't miss out.

Thank you to all our dedicated players who poured their hearts into our multiplayer feedback thread on the Discord channel. It helped us better understand the impact of the changes and review our plans to better adapt to your expectations and how you play the game.
So, as a first step, we’ll be bringing back rewards for the Top 25,000 players! Yep, you read that right; we’re not only bringing back the top 10k rewards but expanding it to Top 25k rewards.

Our initial changes were aimed at making multiplayer even more competitive, but we missed the mark. We have further increased the goal posts, to make sure that Multiplayer isn’t just rewarding our top players and gives a reason for everyone to give it a shot and try their best!
We also heard your thoughts on the current filters and have also readjusted them.

The new filters will kick in at the start of our next MP event next season, and will take a more nuanced approach to determine what cars should be included in each, instead of basing it purely off a car’s rank. This will hopefully lead to more fair matchups and mitigate the impact of EVO cars.
Of course, we will still be keeping a close eye on your feedback throughout the season to see if further changes are needed.

As players can unlock more cars each season nowadays, we’re also boosting the Token to Credits exchange rate to receive more than double (and almost four times in some cases) the number of credits you used to get, so you don’t get stuck when trying to upgrade your new rides.
Those are all the changes included in our upcoming Hotfix, some of which you’ll get to experience in our new upcoming season.
Please remember that our goal is to iterate and evolve these changes, until we hit the sweet spot.
And to get there, we need your feedback and impressions.
Although first impressions are important, please continue to let us know as time moves on how you feel about the changes as we’ll be paying close attention to the Discord server and our socials!

releases.displayName: BALL x PIT: The Shadow Update launches April 27

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649613/904f811f34d895fe63127a23ae27bd8576133a1f.png"]
Hey everyone,
We’re back with more BALL x PIT, as we confirm that our second free update, The Shadow Update, will be released next Monday, April 27!

Time starts to bend in this update, with some new ball evolutions that freeze it and warp it entirely. Expect your runs to get a little more chaotic as we introduce some new balls, passives, and characters alongside the addition of a new building all detailed below!
2 new characters
The Tunneller is a scrappy miner whose shots don’t stop at the edge; they wrap around the screen and come back in from the other side, making just about every angle fair game.
The Tiptoer is a fragile but deadly ninja who stays undetected by enemies at close range at the cost of lower health and damage.
Venom stacks up with each hit, slowing targets and chipping away at them until enough buildup finally locks them in place with paralysis.
Time leans into area control, dropping a timesnare that freezes enemies caught in its range.
Erosion cuts straight through foes, with each hit shaving off a percentage of their current health, making it incredibly nasty against tougher targets.
Time Bomb adds a bit of delayed chaos, planting an explosive that goes off after a short wait.
Timestop does exactly what it sounds like, freezing absolutely everything on the field for a few seconds before going on cooldown.
Warp keeps things unpredictable, blinking to a random spot on the field upon every enemy hit while ramping up speed as it goes.
Sniper shots cut straight through enemies but burn out the moment they hit a wall or loop back, trading longevity for a boosted critical chance that rewards precise enemy line ups.
Heart Swallower gives each hit a certain chance to drain a bit of life and heal you for one while also weakening the target’s attack by a percentage, but remember each enemy can only be drained once.
Plus a few more that we won’t spoil just yet...
4 New Passives
Full Metal Rapier thrives on chaos with each ball scaling its damage based on how many baby balls and enemies are currently on the field.
Arrow of Fate flips defense into offense, making you immune to incoming projectiles and firing back a burst of baby balls whenever you’re hit.
Argent Stopwatch plays with momentum, starting balls off at 150% damage before shaving off 30% with every bounce, so timing and positioning matter more than ever.
Sword Breaker keeps things steady but scalable, lowering base damage to 75% while quietly stacking an extra 1% for every enemy in play.
Better start thinking of a spot to drop the Guildhall! This new building will allow players to re-roll previously chosen character upgrades.

Thank you again to all players supporting and for making BALL x PIT what it is! We hope you’re excited to jump back into the pit when BALL x PIT: The Shadow Update releases for free next week, April 27!
BALL x PIT: The Shadow Update Key Art by Jorge Monlongo

Hey folks,
On Tuesday, June 7, Update 1.0.0 becomes available for play.
This Update includes hundreds of changes, bug fixes and Quality of Life improvements in preparation for the release of Season 1. Here are some of the highlights that you can expect in this Update:
Multiple improvements to soldier gameplay which will result in overall smoother animations and movement.

Weapons received updated netcode to improve bullet hit registration. We’ve also done a further balance pass which includes increased projectile speeds for DMR’s and LMG’s, and improved accuracy for Shotguns.

Multiple new XP events have been added, such as for killing an enemy who recently wounded or killed a squadmate, or when an enemy vehicle you recently damaged is destroyed by a teammate and the occupants are killed
The number of available in-world vehicles has been increased for Conquest which should make it easier to move across the map
Sundance’s Wingsuit has been adjusted to lower overall flight time, while making it easier to maneuver. To simplify their Specialty, the EMP Field Smart Explosive has been removed
We’re excited to get these changes into your hands and we look forward to your feedback when you’ve been able to play and try them out.
On June 7 we’ll release Update 1.0.0 which includes all balance changes, fixes and Quality of Life improvements that are listed below.
Be sure to check out the full Season 1 reveal on June 7 at 8am PDT/ 5pm CEST:
We’ll follow-up with a recap of Season 1 later in the week.
The next Update is currently scheduled for early July. It’s a smaller Update that brings further fixes and changes to the Battlefield. We’ll follow-up with full detail closer to its release.

To stay informed on the roll out of Update 1.0.0, you can follow us on the @BattlefieldComm Twitter account. You can also follow along with our tracking of Known Issues and game changes that we’re able to make in real time on our Battlefield forums.
Voice Chat Channel is now greyed out in the Social Menu when Voice Chat is turned On, but you are unable to switch channels
Online IDs are now displayed in the rewards screen after End of Round when VoIP is enabled
Resolved instances where players could be Squad or Team switched outside of their Party
Quitting an ongoing match no longer automatically puts you back into the matchmaking queue
Resolved Mouse Raw Input Settings sometimes reverting
Resolved instances where switching to Fullscreen would cause the Borderless Window setting to not work on a second monitor
Added missing Voice indicators on Xbox Series X|S when unplugging/plugging in a headset to the controller
Closing the Pause menu no longer briefly shows the hangar lobby background
When disabling Social Communication options via Console, Text-to-speech and Speech-to-text options will now automatically be greyed out in-game
Resolved a flickering microphone indicator when clicking on the VoIP:Party button in the Social screen
Resolved instances where keyboard input was lost and the game window couldn't be focused after alt+tabbing out of game
Resolved instances where in-game QR codes could not be scanned due to resolution issues
Resolved instances where players couldn't be revived at the base of ziplines
Fixed an issue that caused Kill Cards to no longer display attachment names and icons after the first kill
Player nametags are no longer visible before the player models itself becomes visible to other players
Takedown kills now trigger an XP event
Claiming a control panel (ex. sliding doors) now triggers an XP event
Killing an enemy who recently wounded or killed a squadmate now triggers an XP event
Providing smoke cover in which teammates are healed or revived now triggers an XP event
Reviving, healing, repairing or resupplying a squadmate now provides more XP
Damaging an enemy vehicle now triggers an XP event
Providing smoke cover for squadmates who kill enemies or covering enemies who are killed now triggers an assist XP event
Getting a triple kill now triggers an XP event
When an enemy vehicle you recently damaged is destroyed by a teammate, and this kills occupants it will now trigger an assist XP event
Killing an enemy with a headshot now triggers an XP event
Always Traversal Sprint has been added as an option under the Controller tab
A Chat Log Visibility option has been added to allow setting the default visibility mode of the chat log (SHOW, WHEN ACTIVE or HIDE). This option is available under Display > Hud General

Hey everyone,
Season 2: Master of Arms is available for play starting tomorrow, August 30 at 12 UTC.

We have loved every second of playing Season 1 alongside you all. We’re now ready to journey into Season 2 together, and we’re looking forward to seeing you explore our new map, get to know our new Specialist and of course play around with the all-new hardware.
//The Battlefield Team
What’s new in Season 2?
Here is an overview of the new content in Season 2, alongside highlights for changes and improvements:
New Map: Stranded
New Specialist: Charlie Crawford
New Vehicle: EBLC-Ram
New Weapons: AM40, Avancys, PF51
New Gadget: Concussion Grenade
New Vault Weapons: M16A3 & M60E4
New Battlefield Portal Weapons: M2 Carbine, Bren LMG, M95, M249 SAW, AEK-971
New Feature: Assignments
New Battle Pass
What other changes and improvements are included in Update 2.0.0?
A new Home Screen offers a single overview of all available game modes
Rush returns as a permanently available game mode
Stealth Helicopters receive further balance adjustments
Assault Rifles & Submachine Guns receive balance adjustments to Headshot Multipliers
In Breakthrough and Rush, automatically switch to play one round as both Attacker and Defender after EoR before rotating to the next map
Custom Conquest has been added to the Battlefield Portal Builder as a new Conquest game mode with added customizable options for capture points and extra logic options for the Rules Editor.
When can I play?
Season 1 officially ends on August 30 at 08:00 UTC, at which time Update #2.0.0 goes live. Progression on Season 2 content becomes available on the same day at 12:00 UTC.

Once Season 2 is available for play you can jump straight into Stranded, our new map which is available through 24/7 Playlists for both Conquest and Breakthrough. You can also start your journey towards unlocking the new Battle Pass rewards such as our new Specialist Crawford, or the new weapons, vehicle and gadget.
What can you expect from the next game update?

The next game update is currently being assessed for release towards the end of September / start of October. Alongside further fixes and changes, it will include the reworked version of Renewal, the Polaris RZR in-world vehicle, and new Vault Weapons in All-Out Warfare.
Stay Informed

To stay informed on the roll out of Update 2.0, you can follow us on the @BattlefieldComm Twitter account. You can also follow along with our tracking of Known Issues and game changes that we’re able to make in real time on our Battlefield forums.
Head to Panama and a desert lake drained of water. Fight around and inside a beached container ship housing an illicit arms trading center.

We’ve built Stranded from the ground up to be a smaller level with a dedicated CQC space. It’s split into three spaces; North and South spaces are more open, while the central space is where you can expect the CQC chaos to take place.

On the South side, there is a tall tower which lets you move across the level while avoiding combat. There is also a path below the ship which connects the North and South spaces, this lets you traverse across without having to go inside the ship.

We made the decision not to put any flags on top of the ship as we want the main focus for Stranded to be on CQC and infantry play, which take place inside the ship. This infantry focus also means that Stranded will feature no vehicles while playing Breakthrough. Of course, Conquest will still have our full array of vehicles available for play.

The team is extremely excited to get Stranded into your hands. Especially the interior of the ship has given us that close quarters meat grinder feeling during Playtests that we’ve seen you enjoy in for example Metro, and Locker. We’re keen to hear your feedback about how it plays!

The Season 2 Battle Pass brings 100 new tiers of Hardware, Cosmetics and Player Card items to earn. All-new gameplay content such as the new Specialist, Weapons and Vehicles are all available as part of the Free Tiers, while The Premium Tiers give access to further cosmetic rewards.
Deploy as new Specialist Charlie Crawford and use his Mounted Vulcan to support your team and lay down solid defense.
Specialty - Mounted Vulcan - The Mounted Vulcan is a stationary minigun that lays down immense firepower and is particularly effective against infantry and light vehicles.
Trait - Cache Point - Replenish Gadget ammo for friends that you revive.

A fast and highly maneuverable armored reconnaissance and attack vehicle designed for hit-and-run strikes on the enemy. It also comes with the ability to place a Spawn Beacon on the Battlefield on which any member of the friendly team can deploy. It is also equipped with an Active Protection System to intercept incoming anti-vehicle weaponry. This makes the EBLC-RAM perfectly suited to lead flanking attacks on the enemy. But be careful when venturing behind enemy lines, an enemy Tank lurking around the corner is one of your direct counters.
A new Assault Rifle, LMG and Secondary Weapon become available for play.
AM40

Intended for close quarters combat, this ambidextrous weapon delivers an Assault Rifle in an SMG-like package. It’s a versatile and controllable weapon that shines with strong performance in short range combat, while having an increased damage falloff versus other Assault Rifles.
Avancys

Heavy usage of polymers and 3D Printing allow the Avancys to be 20% lighter than the competing Machine Guns while providing unprecedented firepower and adaptability. It’s a versatile weapon skilled at sustained fire.
PF51

Equipped with a P90 magazine, this originally semi-automatic weapon has the ability to fire in full-auto to maximize its personal defense capabilities while sacrificing ammo efficiency. It’s lightweight and perfect for combat over minimal distances.
New Gadget: Concussion Grenade
Upon detonation, this grenade temporarily disorients any enemies caught in its blast radius. Useful for flushing out hostiles that have dug into defensive positions.

Assignments are missions that allow you to unlock new hardware such as weapons, or the gameplay content from a previous Season. You can browse the Assignment for all unlockables via the Collection screen to see which criteria you need to complete. They are permanently available, so you can work towards unlocking them at your own pace.
Two Battlefield Portal iconic weapons from the Battlefield 3 era are now available in the All-Out Warfare arsenal. You’ll unlock these Vault Weapons at your own pace via the new Assignment system.
M16A3
This Assault Rifle comes with an upgraded rail interface system and is capable of Automatic and Semi-Automatic fire. Chambered for 5.56mm and has a 30 round magazine.
M60E4
This LMG E4 variant has a shortened barrel, reduced weight and reliability improvements. It has a deployable bipod for more accuracy at greater distances.

New iconic weapons from our Classic Eras are available to unlock in Battlefield Portal. These weapons are also unlocked via the new Assignments feature and will be accessible when playing across Battlefield Portal.
M2 Carbine - 1942
Building on the success of the M1, the M2 variant allows select fire. Fully-automatic and semi-automatic modes are now fed by a 30 round magazine.
Bren LMG - 1942
This full-auto British assault rifle runs the same cartridge as the BAR 1918 and features a top mounted magazine.
M95 - - Bad Company 2
This .50 caliber, bolt-action, magazine fed, anti-material sniper rifle is a beast. Its long range and power make it a must for enhanced stand-off effectiveness.
M249 SAW - Bad Company 2 / Battlefield 3
The Squad Automatic Weapon is a belt-fed suppressive fire, light machine gun. It chambers the NATO 5.56 round with a 200 round capacity.
AEK-971 - Battlefield 3
Fully-automatic fire, 30 round capacity with a low spread and decent recoil. Optics are suggested for staying on target with those longer bursts.
These new weapons also come with new Scopes to give you even more customization options to fit your gameplay style.
Lastly, the M18 Smoke Grenade is back in Battlefield Portal and can be selected as a Throwable in your Loadout for all Classic eras.
You told us that only having three game modes available via the Home Menu at one time felt limited. We heard you, and made changes so you now have a single overview of all available game modes.

Browse through Conquest, Breakthrough, Portal and Hazard Zone via a single menu to see which Playlists are available. But there’s more. We’re excited to bring back Rush as a permanent available game mode. You asked for it, and it’s here to stay.
Lastly, Once Season 2 goes live we’ll feature 24/7 Playlists on both Conquest and Breakthrough so you’ll be able to jump straight into our new map, Stranded.

On Tuesday, September 13 at 08:00 UTC we are releasing Update #2.0.1.

Alongside a small number of bug fixes we are correcting the visual effects (VFX) of Paik’s EMG-X Scanner for which we Hotfixed the range and duration on September 1. As a result, the Scanner’s VFX no longer extends beyond its effective range. We have also decreased the uptime of the Location Revealed notification for Scanned targets as you’ve told us this notification was intrusive during gameplay.
The next game update includes the Renewal rework, the Polaris RZR and new Vault Weapons and we’ll talk more about that at the end of September / early October.
Stay Informed

Follow us on the @BattlefieldComm Twitter account to stay informed on the roll out of our updates. You can also follow along with our tracking of Known Issues and further game changes we’re making via our Battlefield forums.
The Avancys and AM40 no longer display visible weapon shake when firing after switching from a secondary weapon

Resolved an issue where the “Interact” button would sometimes trigger repeatedly. This could for example cause you to enter a vehicle again directly after exiting it
The EMG-X Scanner VFX now matches the maximum range of this ability (25m)
The Location Revealed notification for spotted target now remains on screen for 0.3s
On October 11 @ 08:00 UTC we are releasing Update 2.1.1.

The main focus of this smaller Quality of Life Update is to improve gunplay. Included are several weapon balance changes and bug fixes to ensure a consistent gameplay experience between our weapon offerings:
The M16A3 and M60E4 now have correct recoil reduction on Consoles to ensure their performance is consistent across all platforms
The M16A3 and M60E4 have received balance changes to improve their performance
The Avancys, K30 and MP9 have received balance changes to reduce their performance
We have resolved an issue that was preventing some players from being able to Aim Down Sights (ADS) after exiting a vehicle
A hit registration issue has been resolved which could occur when using a controller and firing weapons over a sustained period

items.text: The second major game update for Season 2 includes the Orbital map rework, alongside new Vault Weapons. We’ll follow-up with full details closer to its release

Follow us on the @BattlefieldComm Twitter account to stay informed on the roll out of our updates. You can also follow along with our tracking of Known Issues and further game changes we’re making via our Battlefield forums.

Firing continuously with weapons while using a controller would sometimes desync recoil between the client and the server. As a result, shots missed their target when they should have hit. This has been resolved

---- This bug reappeared after we previously rolled out a fix. Please let us know if you continue to experience it after this update
The M16A3 now has the correct Headshot Multiplier for Assault Rifles (2.15x)
The Avancys was highly accurate, and coupled with its large magazine size meant it was too powerful during sustained fire. We have reduced its accuracy to compensate.
Base Recoil increased 0.32 -> 0.36
Dispersion Per Shot increased 0.03 -> 0.06
The K30 is intended to be a close range SMG, and was too accurate at medium distance. Its accuracy at range has therefore been decreased.
Min Dispersion Angle increased 0.15 -> 0.18
Dispersion Per Shot increased 0.09 -> 0.15
Dispersion Decrease Rate reduced 20 -> 4
The MP9 is also intended to be a close range SMG, and similar to the K30 received an accuracy penalty to reduce its effectiveness at medium distances.
Dispersion Per Shot increased 0.06 -> 0.11
Min Dispersion Angle increased 0.14 -> 0.17
The M16A3 did not match the performance of other Assault Rifles. To compensate we have reduced its recoil and improved its accuracy during sustained fire.
Base Recoil reduced 0.44 -> 0.36
First Shot Recoil Multiplier reduced 1.45 -> 1.15
Dispersion Per Shot on ADS reduced 0.13 -> 0.1
The M60E4 did not match the performance of other LMGs. To compensate we have reduced its recoil and improved its accuracy during sustained fire.
Base Recoil reduced 0.6 -> 0.54
Dispersion per Shot on ADS reduced 022 -> 0.17
Reduced Stepped Recoil Multiplier from 6 bullets to 4
Damage Increased on all ranges

Hey everyone,
Season 3 for Battlefield™ 2042 deploys across all platforms on Tuesday, November 22 at 12:00 UTC, while Update 3.0.0 goes live at 08:00 UTC.
Tensions continue to escalate as our squad of No-Pats head to the Northern Swedish wilderness within Season 3: Escalation.
Here is an overview of the new content in the Season 3 Update, alongside highlights for changes and improvements:
New Map: Spearhead
New Specialist: Rasheed Zain
New Vehicle: EMKV90-TOR
New Weapons: Rorsch Mk-4, NVK-P125, NVK-S22
New Gadget: Throwing Knife
New Vault Weapons: XM8 LMG, A-91
New Battle Pass

Season 2 of Battlefield 2042 officially comes to a close on November 22nd at 08:00 UTC, at which point Update #3.0.0 will go live for all platforms. Season 3: Escalation will release on the same day at 12:00 UTC, along with progression towards that content.

Once Season 3 is available for play you will be able to jump into our latest map, Spearhead. We are introducing 24/7 playlists for both Conquest and Breakthrough, and you’ll be able to begin working your way through unlocks within our latest Battle Pass where the all-new Specialist, Weapons, a new Vehicle, Gadget, and loads of Cosmetics await you.
